protocol.status: Post-hoc diagnostic supplement; not a preregistered pilot or replacement score.
protocol.inventory: All 120 original anchors; EN independently timed intact AMI word nodes, KO explicit item[5] pWord.ortho. Hangul, JA complete untagged EAF phrases, ZH ineligible. Original parent flags retained; no nearest-word fallback.
protocol.source_identity: Recording + annotation hash + original word/interval/annotation ID. Keep duplicates, annotated positive-duration different-speaker overlap, and repeated source text visible. Units sharing recordings/speakers/context are not independent trials.
protocol.cutoff: Original parent span end + 1 second. Independent online/eventual Journal.snapshot; only exported capture-time source mapping and cutoff-canonical IDs. Never remap with the eventual send ledger.
protocol.surface: Soniox final append order then current partial. E0 indexed segments in segment_index/word_index order then current partial; missing segment indices are barriers. Unindexed timestamp families stay separate text/timing diagnostics, never supply indexed identity or adjacency.
protocol.matching: Whole consecutive native-piece spans; normalize concatenated raw text with NFKC, casefold, Unicode alphanumeric only. Retain punctuation/spacing, untimed/unmapped lexical barriers and combining extensions. EN/KO reject raw adjacent letter/digit/mark boundaries. No fuzzy matching, substring within pieces, tokenization invention, collars, point-coverage requirement or time widening.
protocol.localization: Every contributing lexical piece must have mapped positive-duration source bounds positively intersecting the independent unit interval. Preserve provider/source bounds and source_ranges. Reject discontinuous/partial/padding mapping and backward source/provider progression; silence gaps are allowed.
protocol.ambiguity: Enumerate localized occurrences without speaker/reference-ID knowledge. Distinct observation occurrences, including replay copies, remain ambiguous. Collapse only punctuation wrappers with identical lexical observation provenance.
protocol.identity: Exactly one localized occurrence; every contributing lexical piece must have one known unanimous (session,native-ID). Any unknown retains missing_speaker; multiple known IDs retain mixed_identity, including both flags together. Punctuation/control/audio-event IDs never vote. Apply original fixed arm/record/session mapping last; unanimous unmatched ID is wrong, not excluded.
protocol.denominators: C/W/U, assigned coverage, conditional accuracy and correct coverage use the same source-eligible inventory. Report EN word, KO word, JA phrase and annotated-overlap strata; pooled rows are descriptive, not a global provider ranking. The 24 source-ineligible rows are not provider failures.
limits: Fixed maps were optimized for the old point metric, not these units; do not refit.
KO covers only one reference speaker; no annotated overlap does not prove absence.
ZH has no lexical truth. JA whole phrases are harder strict matching units than words.
Normalization erases punctuation/whitespace and is not linguistic or semantic equivalence; no script conversion, stemming or number expansion.
Whole-piece boundaries, raw boundary ambiguity, substitutions and timing disagreement can prevent support; lexical mismatch is not an ASR-deletion verdict.
E0 unindexed timing availability is separate from indexed identity/timing availability; no text/adjacency correlation is inferred.
Corpus annotations are not new listening/adjudication. No product change, N lexical score, T1/T2 work, provider/MT/GUI call or turn-prediction adoption.
